result.result_summary: Promoted within the scope of the registered sets. The defect of DEF-TRANS-13 reproduces on real documents: on the 280 order-preserving deletion cases the E12-H61 conjunction flags 678 kept and 472 removed statements in 246 cases, and in 257 of the 280 cases its flag array changes with the choice among plan entries that are equal within 1e-12 (259 cases hold such a tie). The lever, moved read on the one-to-one matched pairs at c = 0.325 with eps = 1e-6, flags 0 statements in 280/280 cases, is flag for flag equal to the conjunction on 1680/1680 verbatim permutations, keeps 13675/13675 conjunction-flagged true relocations on the reworded reorders with 0 false fires, and reads the four fixtures as registered. Without a bar: on 11277 reordered-and-deleted cases the lever reads precision 1.0000 and recall 1.0000 against conjunction 0.7624 and 0.8779. Five executor passes outside the record mark the limits. Reworded survivors: lever 0/280 cases, conjunction 250/280. Long document without repeated statements: lever 0/120. Long document with 9 repeated statements: lever 4/120 cases with the registered tie-break, 31/120 without it. Single transpositions at 20 and 40 statements: flag arrays equal on 183/190 and 765/780, because the shipped norm j/n - i/n and the lever's shift/n are different float forms at a rank step of exactly 5% of the length. Cutoff: the largest true reworded pair costs 0.322901, 0.002099 below the cutoff; at c = 0.32 retention is 0.9894 with 112 false fires and at c = 0.3 it is 0.9769, below the bar. With document B encoded in its own call, every arm's flag array equals its row-copy reading in 280/280 deletion cases (rows bitwise equal in 259/280, largest entry difference 6.864e-03)
result.caveats: Scope: the registered sets hold documents of 11 to 14 statements with 0 repeated statements, one encoder (OpenVINO INT8) and one paraphrase method (opus-mt back-translation). Clause 1 holds by construction on that set (byte-identical survivors, unique zero-cost assignment); the readings that are not by construction are the executor passes on reworded survivors (0/280) and on documents encoded in separate calls (flag arrays equal to the row-copy reading in 280/280 deletion cases; the 120 sampled permutations return bitwise equal rows in 120/120, so that part repeats the row-copy input). The ladder reading (precision and recall 1.0000) also holds by construction: the matching pairs every survivor with its own copy in 11277/11277 cases and the cases hold 9 to 12 matched pairs. Clause 2 does not transfer to every length: on single transpositions of the fixture document source the flag arrays are equal on 91/91 at 14 statements, 183/190 at 20 and 765/780 at 40; in the differing cases the conjunction flags 14 and 30 statements that the lever does not, and the lever flags none that the conjunction does not. Clause 3 does not separate the lever from the baseline: 0 of the 124 true reworded pairs cost at or above the cutoff and the largest is 0.002099 below it; the evidence line of the record cites the same 124 pairs for the cutoff; with 1 pair above (c = 0.32) retention is 0.9894 with 112 false fires, with 2 pairs above (c = 0.3) it is 0.9769. Repeated statements: on the fixture document source (9 statements with the text '-') the lever with the registered tie-break flags statements in 4/120 order-preserving deletion cases, all at prefix length 14; in 2 of them the positional term of the wrong matching equals that of the true matching and in 2 it is smaller. Executor rules where the record is open: the deletion set is verified at c = 0.6, the cutoff E13-H70 registered, with c = 0.325 beside it; clause 4 requires both E12-H61 reversal fixtures; a ~bt document is used when it names its base, has the same statement count, equals the stored .bt.json and every statement and its reword are mutual cheapest partners (10/10 bases pass); a plan row is tied when its two largest entries differ by at most 1e-12 (245/280 cases under exact float equality). The tie-resolution reading enumerates the argmax choices of the measured plan, not other optimal plans. The notebook places the harness check before the kill-gate, as the record orders it; the primer lists the kill-gate section first. In the two copied loops the container names REORDER and STATEMENTS replace the names of the origin notebooks; the copied functions are verbatim. The notebook was executed more than once while it was built; the outputs are those of the last execution and every verdict threshold is a number the record or the campaign primer states. The long document of the executor passes is the fixture document source, whose 62 statements include markup fragments; it is one document and no bar is registered for it. Not measured: insertions and substitutions on real documents beyond the E12-H61 fixtures, pairs with statements without a counterpart on both sides

(8) The prediction check is honest; it states that the retention part does not separate the arms.
